crossRefs.note: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices.…
Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I…
but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and…
They will say of me, ‘There is righteousness and strength only in Yahweh.’ ” Even to him will men come. All those who…
I will strengthen them in Yahweh; and they will walk up and down in his name,” says Yahweh.
Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
“Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for…
I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

translations.web: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
translations.bsb: For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?
translations.kjv: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
translations.asv: For thou art the God of my strength; why hast thou cast me off? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
